instructions: You build worlds in the world language that do what their briefs say, and you check them honestly.

content.text:
**No. The cascade starts, but stalls at flap1.** Pendulum1 strikes ball1 at 0.41 s; ball1 reaches cart1 at 1.79 s; cart1 hits domino1 at 2.30 s; and domino1 touches flap1 at 2.49 s. However, domino1 misses the release ear, so flap1 remains latched and ball2 never leaves its holding position.

Separately, ball3 is still unsupported by ramp3 and falls to the floor. Block1 stays on its cradle, door1 and pendulum2 remain inactive, and ball4 stays on shelf1. Cart2’s slowly creeping assist arms eventually contact ring1, which is an unintended interference.

The revision below moves the release fingers into the dominoes’ swept regions, rebuilds ramp3 along the working x direction, and routes cart2’s long assist arms outside ring1. It has not yet been simulated.
